Octave version: 11.3.0

* Factorization method: [Principal axis](https://gnu-octave.github.io/statistics/factoran.html)
* Rotation method: Unknown (varimax according to Gemini)

```{octave}
% Set up environment
clear all;

pkg load statistics


% Read in data
fid = fopen('dat/EFA/efa_R_Roberson.csv', 'r');

data = csvread(fid);

fclose(fid);

% Run EFA
[loadings, specificities] = factoran(data, 4);

loadings
chi_square = NA
CFI        = NA
TLI        = NA
RMSEA      = NA
```
